metadata.scope: Lossless PNG of the canvas bitmap at this submitted draw; excludes page UI, linear/HDR buffers and compositor presentation. Capture is not a performance sample.
metadata.uniformScope: CPU-side values submitted to Three uniforms at this draw; GPU float32 rounding is not read back.

frame.counterScope: Frame-loop draw calls in this engine owner, including regeneration draws; not GPU completion or presentation

terrainRaster.geometryScope: First visible triangle of this static stitched mesh; not exact analytic-height intersection

shadow.coverage: 128km square in light right/up coordinates, centered at [0,-4,0], outer 15% fades to lit; not global terrain shadows
shadow.colourFormat: r32float relative solar height km; -1000000 clear
shadow.filter: One nearest textureLoad; no receiver-plane extrapolation or PCF blur; outside coverage lit
shadow.biasPolicy: Caster affine height minimum over one actual light texel: 0.5*(abs(dpdx(q))+abs(dpdy(q))) +1m; erodes unresolved contact shadows, especially at low Sun
shadow.receiverPolicy: Only shadow lookup point elevated along planet radial by half one light texel; geometry/radiance point unchanged; contact shadows below this scale may disappear
shadow.biasLimit: No guarantee for multiple non-coplanar faces inside one light texel; aliasing and contact-shadow loss require visual qualification
shadow.updates: Exact-input cached shadow map; terrain colour draw remains live; shared geometry not owned by shadow

cache.scope: Owner-local CPU calls: requests are validated render calls, submissions are renderer.render attempts (including throws), hits skip shadow clear/draw; no GPU completion or presentation claim
cache.ownership: Static casters and exclusive target; call invalidate after caster mutations, external target writes or same-owner renderer/backend reset; disposed owner is terminal

terrainRaster.distanceComponent: alpha; km from actual camera origin; -1 miss
terrainRaster.normalPolicy: Shared incident-area-weighted actual mesh normal at every vertex; no bilinear-source gradient seams
terrainRaster.memoryScope: Nominal retained geometry and target/depth payload only; CPU construction temporaries and driver residency/peak are unmeasured
terrainRaster.cache: No cached geometry pass; terrain shading stays live each render

densitySampling.allocationAccounting: nominal payload; GPU upload/residency not measured

clocks.note: Precipitation uniform is applied before this frame advances forcingTime. A frozen flow texture retains its installation time/dispersion even while flowUniformTime advances.

skyTextures.scope: Owner-local texture objects and upload revisions; not portable content hashes.

identity.scope: CPU-retained exact source array identities used to construct the installed texture objects; no GPU readback or full-buffer hash.

report.scope: Read-only ideal CPU trilinear sampling of installed buffers, then one Float32 round per stored endpoint. No GPU filter parity, light/model bake, rendering, mutation or artistic acceptance.

sha256.scope: Not computed here. Owner may attach previously verified identities separately; byte lengths are not content hashes.

coordinates.filter: Ideal trilinear UNORM8, clamp-to-edge, mip0, half-texel coordinate p=uvw*N-.5. No repeat, flow, growth, drift or second warp.

statistics.quantiles: Inverse empirical CDF, nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1 clamped at0. Weighted CDF uses integer positive R codes and first cumulative weight>=p*total. No quantile interpolation.
statistics.currentSolarDepth: mix(mix(dayLeft,dayRight,lightSide),mix(sunsetLeft,sunsetRight,lightSide),sunsetAmount); optional current preview is separately packed before visibility.
statistics.normalization: None. No histogram fit, threshold, gain or physical precipitation calibration.

packedUNORM8.endpointCodeMeaning: Codes0/255 include values rounded to the endpoint; not proof that original 3D bake was exactly0 or clipped16.

rWeighted.weightUnit: R byte code; divide by255 for sum of normalized source strengths, not physical water mass.

gate.supportDefinition: Positive R cells plus R0 cells with an in-domain positive Chebyshev1 neighbour, including diagonals. Not AABB or cloud supportBounds.
gate.interpretation: No positive source: no rain-light trial. Identical BA at the selected endpoint: stop for that endpoint; it adds no spatial light signal. All stored raw fields constant: no spatial signal for any scalar blend. Merely constant packed endpoint fields do NOT prove constancy after intermediate blending. Variation is necessary, never sufficient for native/art PASS.

current.limitation: Variation only in the R0 halo or tiny response differences do not establish useful positive-source contrast or native quality.

resources.memoryScope: Borrowed source buffers, no full-buffer copies/hashes. Additional bounded 256-bin count arrays, at most4096 distinct packed BA pairs per summary, and compact report JSON; terminal process RSS is not measured by this helper.

limitations: CPU values are not actual WebGPU texture-filter readback or f32 ALU proof.
Source/base64 field resolution and tau16 clipping are inherited; no information is reconstructed below that resolution.
Quantile variation does not establish credible rain shading; emitter visibility is not physical visibility at a descended droplet.
Fixed witnesses may all be empty or miss important patterns; they are not an adaptive selected-case guarantee.
Current state is owner-submitted CPU metadata, not GPU f32 uniform/filter readback. Packed BA is a hypothetical cache representation, not installed data.

textExport.format: Consecutive text parts of the PNG data URL; concatenate in order without separators.
